## Orientation

Write root: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/area-levels--fix-area-levels-app-size` on task branch `task/area-levels/fix-area-levels-app-size`.
Other tasks in this wave run in their own worktrees. Do not touch them.
Do not edit anything under `.canon/`.

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R9: The product index has no left rail.

## Approach

The suite run at the phase head failed `tests/dashboard/test_ui_structure.py::test_r3_app_svelte_has_fewer_than_150_lines`: `App.svelte` has 153 lines. Move the global keydown handler (theme key `t` and Esc on the journal route) out of `src/App.svelte` into a function in a new `src/lib/state/keys.ts` (for example `handleKey(event, toggleTheme)`), and call it from `onMount`. Behavior must not change. Do not edit the protected test files. Run `uv run pytest tests/dashboard/test_ui_structure.py -q` and `npm run lint`, `npm run check`, `npm test` in `dashboard/frontend`.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R9: The product index has no left rail.

### Design / decisions (quote)

Invariants:
- Hash routing only. One served document.
- The product index and the area page write nothing.
- An idea never renders among the efforts.
- The URL decides the selected effort.

Assumptions:
- Phase `effort-area-link` is merged, so `area` is on every snapshot effort.
- The Home screen needs no change other than the chip.
- The Playwright seed store can hold an area and a placement.

Decisions:
- landing-product-index: #/ shows the product index, one card for each area; the effort Home moves to #/effort/<name>
